design_contract: The large physical claw-shell gauntlet with a blue spherical core is the primary weapon. The fully energy-based scythe is a shape generated by that gauntlet, not a standalone replacement weapon. Keep the original gauntlet's prominent silhouette and core visible.

params.prompt:
EDIT IMAGE 1. IMAGE 2 is the authoritative reference for the woman's PRIMARY WEAPON: the enormous black claw-shell ARCANE GAUNTLET enclosing a large bright blue spherical core. Restore that specific main weapon prominently to image 1. The ordinary small gloves in image 1 are a design error. Do NOT copy the sword from image 2.
CRITICAL WEAPON HIERARCHY: the GAUNTLET is the permanent physical main weapon worn over the woman's hand and forearm. The giant SCYTHE is a temporary form of PURE BLUE ENERGY projected by that gauntlet. These must read as one coherent main-weapon system. The gauntlet is not replaced by a standalone scythe. Restore the large overlapping curved jagged black-metal claw plates framing the unmistakable blue spherical orbital core exactly in the spirit, scale, material and visual identity of image 2. The sphere should be approximately the width of her face or larger, with clearly readable metallic claw shells around it; do not shrink it into a wrist jewel, a small circular watch, ordinary glove trim, floating orb or a scythe ornament. The gauntlet wraps the real hand and continues along the forearm with a clear anatomical attachment. Forearm, wrist, hand and claw housing must remain connected and plausible.
Place this large core gauntlet prominently on the woman's FOREGROUND arm at SCREEN LEFT, beside and forward of her upper torso, with its blue spherical core and dark claws presented toward the camera. Adjust that forearm/hand just enough to expose the whole core and its claw-shell silhouette. Preserve the face and never cover it. Show visible blue energy emerging from WITHIN this gauntlet's core and continuously shaping the scythe's luminous shaft at that hand. The shaft must be directly joined to the core emission, not a detached physical pole that a normal glove happens to hold. Her other armored hand can lightly stabilize the lower energy shaft, with natural fingers. The large gauntlet remains physically black-metal armor with the blue core, while EVERY part of the generated SCYTHE (shaft, blade and end) remains pure luminous semi-transparent blue arcane energy.
Retain image 1's elegant enormous single-sided energy scythe: one long narrow hooked blade arcing above her hood, a blue energy shaft running diagonally down-right across the scene. Adjust its local root/shaft position minimally for the direct core connection. Keep the whole blade tip visible. Do not reintroduce a metal blade or metal pole. Keep coherent blue plasma with internal filaments and controlled glow, not an explosive cloud that conceals the gauntlet. The gauntlet's black claw plates and big spherical core must be independently readable at thumbnail size.
Preserve image 1's exact female face, expression, silver hair, hood, body, costume, the background man and his existing blue bow, cathedral and lightning, atmosphere, framing and EXODUSER / HELL LORD title. No new characters, extra limbs, extra hands, duplicate gauntlets floating in the scene, extra weapons, panels or labels. This is a still illustration for image approval. Highest priority: faithfully restore the original BIG CORE GAUNTLET as the primary weapon, clearly shown as the source that projects the giant pure-energy scythe.

review.observed: Large blue spherical orbital core surrounded by overlapping black claw-shell gauntlet plates restored on the screen-left foreground arm. Gauntlet remains visually prominent with the energy shaft joining at its side; one support hand remains lower on the shaft. Scythe shaft and long hooked blade remain luminous blue energy. Female face/hair/hood, male archer/bow, cathedral and title recognizable.
review.limitations: Core is presented front-on and housing obscures much of the emitting hand; finger/forearm attachment is not fully exposed. Generative editing adjusts armor details and local lighting. This is a visual review image, not a rig or proof of animation mechanics.
review.approval_status: Awaiting image review. No new video or game runtime integration.
